slides.title: 串起多层漏斗，一层层筛掉分子
slides.audio_script: 上一节你只有 Lipinski 一道关卡。这一节我们要干件大事：把好几道关卡串成一条管道，这就是多层漏斗。5000 个候选先过第一层，活下来的再过第二层、再下一层，越筛越少。你要亲手把这条漏斗搭起来，跑一遍 5000 个分子，再画成一张瀑布图。

payload.inline_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 1280 720' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect width='1280' height='720' fill='#0f1419'/><text x='640' y='230' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='60' font-weight='700' fill='#f5f7fa' text-anchor='middle'>串起多层漏斗</text><text x='640' y='315' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='60' font-weight='700' fill='#4fd1c5' text-anchor='middle'>一层层筛掉分子</text><g text-anchor='middle'><polygon points='430,420 850,420 740,560 540,560' fill='#1a2531' stroke='#4fd1c5' stroke-width='3'/><text x='640' y='405' font-family='monospace' font-size='30' fill='#8b9bb0'>5000 个候选</text><text x='640' y='500' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='28' fill='#f5f7fa'>一层层过</text><rect x='600' y='560' width='80' height='50' fill='#102018' stroke='#4fd1c5'/><text x='640' y='650' font-family='monospace' font-size='28' fill='#4fd1c5'>最后剩几个</text></g></svg>
payload.hero_title: 串起多层漏斗，一层层筛掉分子
payload.hero_subtitle: 几千个候选分子，怎么一层层筛到只剩几个？

slides.title: 一道关卡，远远不够
slides.audio_script: 上一节你学会了用 Lipinski 给一个分子盖个章，判它像不像药。可这只是一道关卡，只管一件事。它放行的分子里，可能还藏着化不开水的、有毒的、跟老药长得太像的。这些毛病它一个都查不出来，你得让别的关卡来管。

payload.inline_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 1280 720' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect width='1280' height='720' fill='#0f1419'/><text x='640' y='110' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='44' font-weight='700' fill='#f5f7fa' text-anchor='middle'>一道 Lipinski，管不了这么多事</text><g text-anchor='middle'><rect x='460' y='200' width='360' height='110' rx='14' fill='#1a2b1f' stroke='#4fd1c5'/><text x='640' y='250' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='30' fill='#4fd1c5'>Lipinski 放行</text><text x='640' y='292' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='24' fill='#8b9bb0'>判它像不像药</text></g><g font-family='sans-serif' font-size='26' text-anchor='middle'><rect x='180' y='420' width='300' height='100' rx='12' fill='#2b1a1a' stroke='#e57373'/><text x='330' y='470' fill='#e57373'>可能化不开水</text><text x='330' y='505' font-size='22' fill='#8b9bb0'>溶解度太差</text><rect x='500' y='420' width='280' height='100' rx='12' fill='#2b1a1a' stroke='#e57373'/><text x='640' y='470' fill='#e57373'>可能有毒</text><text x='640' y='505' font-size='22' fill='#8b9bb0'>查不出来</text><rect x='800' y='420' width='300' height='100' rx='12' fill='#2b1a1a' stroke='#e57373'/><text x='950' y='470' fill='#e57373'>跟老药太像</text><text x='950' y='505' font-size='22' fill='#8b9bb0'>做了也没意思</text></g><text x='640' y='620' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='28' fill='#6b7b90' text-anchor='middle'>每种毛病，都得让另一道关卡来管</text></svg>
bullets: 上一节 Lipinski 只是一道关卡，只管「像不像药」这一件事
它放行的分子里，还可能藏着化不开水的、有毒的、跟老药太像的
这些毛病，Lipinski 一道关卡一个都查不出来

slides.title: 把关卡首尾串成一条流水线
slides.audio_script: 真实的药物筛选是这样干的：把好几道关卡首尾接成一条流水线，让一大批分子从头流到尾，每过一道就刷掉一批，活下来的才往下走。开头浩浩荡荡几千个，到末尾只剩几个，上头宽下头窄，活像一只漏斗。科学家正是这么从上百万个分子里筛出几个真值得试的。

payload.inline_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 1280 720' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect width='1280' height='720' fill='#0f1419'/><text x='640' y='100' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='44' font-weight='700' fill='#f5f7fa' text-anchor='middle'>关卡一节接一节，像水管串起来</text><g text-anchor='middle'><rect x='120' y='280' width='200' height='160' rx='12' fill='#1a2531' stroke='#4fd1c5'/><text x='220' y='350' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='26' fill='#4fd1c5'>第 1 层</text><text x='220' y='390' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='22' fill='#8b9bb0'>Lipinski</text><text x='370' y='370' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='40' fill='#8b9bb0'>→</text><rect x='420' y='280' width='200' height='160' rx='12' fill='#1a2531' stroke='#4fd1c5'/><text x='520' y='350' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='26' fill='#4fd1c5'>第 2 层</text><text x='520' y='390' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='22' fill='#8b9bb0'>查溶解</text><text x='670' y='370' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='40' fill='#8b9bb0'>→</text><rect x='720' y='280' width='200' height='160' rx='12' fill='#1a2531' stroke='#4fd1c5'/><text x='820' y='350' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='26' fill='#4fd1c5'>第 3 层</text><text x='820' y='390' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='22' fill='#8b9bb0'>查毒性</text><text x='970' y='370' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='40' fill='#4fd1c5'>→</text><rect x='1020' y='305' width='150' height='110' rx='12' fill='#102018' stroke='#4fd1c5'/><text x='1095' y='370' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='26' fill='#4fd1c5'>幸存者</text></g><g font-family='monospace' font-size='24' text-anchor='middle' fill='#6b7b90'><text x='220' y='500'>5000</text><text x='520' y='500'>1800</text><text x='820' y='500'>600</text><text x='1095' y='500'>12</text></g><text x='640' y='600' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='28' fill='#6b7b90' text-anchor='middle'>上一层吐出的「活着的」，正好是下一层的输入</text></svg>
bullets: 真实筛选：把好几道关卡首尾接成流水线，分子从头流到尾
每过一道关卡，刷掉一批，活下来的才继续往下走
开头几千个，到末尾只剩几个——上头宽、下头窄，活像漏斗

slides.title: 多层漏斗：每一层都得过（且），便宜的层排前面
slides.audio_script: 漏斗的脾气，记住三句话。一，把几道关卡首尾串成一条管道，上一层活着的喂给下一层。二，分子得每一层都过才活到最后——这是且的关系，任何一层拦下它就立刻出局。三，便宜快的关卡排前面先把大批不行的廉价刷掉，又慢又贵的判断只伺候活下来的少数。

payload.inline_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 1280 720' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect width='1280' height='720' fill='#0f1419'/><text x='640' y='90' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='42' font-weight='700' fill='#4fd1c5' text-anchor='middle'>多层漏斗的三条脾气</text><g text-anchor='middle'><rect x='120' y='180' width='340' height='360' rx='16' fill='#1a2531' stroke='#3a4a5a'/><text x='290' y='250' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='30' fill='#f5f7fa'>① 串成管道</text><text x='290' y='320' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='24' fill='#8b9bb0'>关卡首尾相接</text><text x='290' y='370' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='24' fill='#8b9bb0'>上层活的喂下层</text><text x='290' y='450' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='40' fill='#4fd1c5'>→→→</text></g><g text-anchor='middle'><rect x='480' y='180' width='320' height='360' rx='16' fill='#1a2531' stroke='#3a4a5a'/><text x='640' y='250' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='30' fill='#f5f7fa'>② 每层都过(且)</text><text x='640' y='320' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='24' fill='#8b9bb0'>第1关 且 第2关 且…</text><text x='640' y='380' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='24' fill='#e57373'>任一层拦下 = 出局</text><text x='640' y='450' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='22' fill='#6b7b90'>不是「满足任一条」</text></g><g text-anchor='middle'><rect x='820' y='180' width='340' height='360' rx='16' fill='#1a2531' stroke='#3a4a5a'/><text x='990' y='250' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='30' fill='#f5f7fa'>③ 便宜的排前</text><text x='990' y='320' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='24' fill='#4fd1c5'>快关卡先刷一大批</text><text x='990' y='380' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='24' fill='#ffb74d'>贵关卡只伺候少数</text><text x='990' y='450' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='22' fill='#6b7b90'>整条漏斗又快又省</text></g><text x='640' y='620' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='26' fill='#6b7b90' text-anchor='middle'>每层只往下传「活着的」，所以越往后剩得越少，漏斗越收越窄</text></svg>

slides.title: 看：5000 个分子流过一层层关卡
slides.audio_script: 看动画里 5000 个分子从漏斗大口倒进去，流过第一层被刷掉一大批、少一截，活下来的再流过第二层、又少一截，一层层往下走，每过一关就瘦一圈，最后只剩稀稀拉拉十几个。注意：被刷掉的分子直接掉出去，后面的层连看都不看它。

payload.inline_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 1280 720' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect width='1280' height='720' fill='#0f1419'/><text x='640' y='80' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='40' font-weight='700' fill='#f5f7fa' text-anchor='middle'>越往下越窄，被刷的直接掉出去</text><g text-anchor='middle'><polygon points='340,150 940,150 820,260 460,260' fill='#16202a' stroke='#4fd1c5' stroke-width='2'/><text x='640' y='215' font-family='monospace' font-size='28' fill='#4fd1c5'>5000</text><polygon points='460,290 820,290 720,400 560,400' fill='#16202a' stroke='#4fd1c5' stroke-width='2'/><text x='640' y='355' font-family='monospace' font-size='26' fill='#4fd1c5'>1800</text><polygon points='560,430 720,430 670,540 610,540' fill='#16202a' stroke='#4fd1c5' stroke-width='2'/><text x='640' y='500' font-family='monospace' font-size='24' fill='#4fd1c5'>600</text><rect x='600' y='560' width='80' height='60' rx='6' fill='#102018' stroke='#4fd1c5'/><text x='640' y='600' font-family='monospace' font-size='24' fill='#4fd1c5'>12</text></g><g font-family='sans-serif' font-size='22' fill='#e57373' text-anchor='start'><text x='960' y='280'>← 被第1层刷掉 3200</text><text x='960' y='420'>← 被第2层刷掉 1200</text><text x='960' y='530'>← 被第3层刷掉 588</text></g><text x='640' y='680' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='26' fill='#6b7b90' text-anchor='middle'>每层只把「活着的」往下递，掉出去的不再回来</text></svg>

slides.title: 漏斗跑完，攒下一串「剩多少」
slides.audio_script: 漏斗跑完，你手里攒下一串很有意思的数：开头 5000，过完第一层剩多少，第二层剩多少，一直到最后剩几个。这串数把整条漏斗的身材全说清了。可光这么干巴巴摆着，哪层砍得最狠、最后瘦成什么样，不好一眼看出来。所以下一格给你一张专门画它的图——瀑布图。

payload.inline_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 1280 720' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect width='1280' height='720' fill='#0f1419'/><text x='640' y='130' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='44' font-weight='700' fill='#f5f7fa' text-anchor='middle'>一串干巴巴的数，看着费劲</text><g font-family='monospace' font-size='34' text-anchor='middle'><rect x='220' y='280' width='160' height='120' rx='12' fill='#1a2531' stroke='#3a4a5a'/><text x='300' y='335' font-size='22' fill='#8b9bb0'>初始</text><text x='300' y='378' fill='#f5f7fa'>5000</text><rect x='420' y='280' width='160' height='120' rx='12' fill='#1a2531' stroke='#3a4a5a'/><text x='500' y='335' font-size='22' fill='#8b9bb0'>第1层</text><text x='500' y='378' fill='#f5f7fa'>1800</text><rect x='620' y='280' width='160' height='120' rx='12' fill='#1a2531' stroke='#3a4a5a'/><text x='700' y='335' font-size='22' fill='#8b9bb0'>第2层</text><text x='700' y='378' fill='#f5f7fa'>600</text><rect x='820' y='280' width='160' height='120' rx='12' fill='#1a2531' stroke='#3a4a5a'/><text x='900' y='335' font-size='22' fill='#8b9bb0'>第3层</text><text x='900' y='378' fill='#f5f7fa'>12</text></g><text x='640' y='520' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='30' fill='#4fd1c5' text-anchor='middle'>哪层砍得最狠？最后到底剩几个？</text><text x='640' y='580' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='26' fill='#6b7b90' text-anchor='middle'>数字一多脑子就糊——换张图，一眼就懂</text></svg>
bullets: 开头 5000，过完第一层剩多少，第二层剩多少……一直到最后
光看这串数字干巴巴，哪层砍得最狠、最后剩几个，不好看出来
所以下一格给你一张专门画这串数的图——瀑布图

slides.title: 瀑布图：每根柱子是过完那层后的剩余，落差揭示砍得多狠
slides.audio_script: 瀑布图把一层层关卡横着排开，每道关卡头上立一根柱子，柱子高矮就是过完这层后还剩多少。越往后剩得越少，柱子一根比一根矮，排成往下走的台阶，像瀑布。读它有两招：相邻两根柱子落差越大，中间那道关卡砍得越狠；头尾一对比，就知道 5000 个最后收到几个。

payload.inline_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 1280 720' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect width='1280' height='720' fill='#0f1419'/><text x='640' y='80' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='42' font-weight='700' fill='#4fd1c5' text-anchor='middle'>瀑布图：一串往下走的台阶</text><line x1='180' y1='560' x2='1120' y2='560' stroke='#3a4a5a' stroke-width='2'/><g text-anchor='middle'><rect x='230' y='150' width='150' height='410' fill='#1a3a44' stroke='#4fd1c5' stroke-width='2'/><text x='305' y='135' font-family='monospace' font-size='26' fill='#f5f7fa'>5000</text><text x='305' y='600' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='22' fill='#8b9bb0'>初始</text><rect x='430' y='340' width='150' height='220' fill='#1a3a44' stroke='#4fd1c5' stroke-width='2'/><text x='505' y='325' font-family='monospace' font-size='26' fill='#f5f7fa'>1800</text><text x='505' y='600' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='22' fill='#8b9bb0'>第1层</text><rect x='630' y='470' width='150' height='90' fill='#1a3a44' stroke='#4fd1c5' stroke-width='2'/><text x='705' y='455' font-family='monospace' font-size='26' fill='#f5f7fa'>600</text><text x='705' y='600' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='22' fill='#8b9bb0'>第2层</text><rect x='830' y='545' width='150' height='15' fill='#1a3a44' stroke='#4fd1c5' stroke-width='2'/><text x='905' y='530' font-family='monospace' font-size='26' fill='#f5f7fa'>12</text><text x='905' y='600' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='22' fill='#8b9bb0'>第3层</text></g><text x='505' y='250' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='24' fill='#ffb74d' text-anchor='middle'>↓ 落差最大</text><text x='505' y='280' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='22' fill='#ffb74d' text-anchor='middle'>砍得最狠</text><text x='640' y='680' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='26' fill='#6b7b90' text-anchor='middle'>柱高 = 该层后剩余；相邻落差 = 该层淘汰量</text></svg>

slides.title: 玩：搭漏斗、调顺序，看瀑布图怎么变
slides.audio_script: 游戏里给你几道关卡，你来把它们首尾串成一条漏斗，让 5000 个分子流过。你可以调关卡的顺序、松紧关卡的门槛，每改一下，右边的瀑布图就跟着变。试着找出哪种排法又快又省、哪道关卡砍得最狠，别让某层卡太严误杀了好分子。

payload.inline_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 1280 720' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect width='1280' height='720' fill='#0f1419'/><text x='640' y='70' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='40' font-weight='700' fill='#f5f7fa' text-anchor='middle'>拖关卡排顺序，瀑布图实时变</text><g text-anchor='middle'><text x='320' y='150' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='26' fill='#8b9bb0'>你的漏斗</text><rect x='180' y='180' width='280' height='70' rx='10' fill='#1a2b1f' stroke='#4fd1c5'/><text x='320' y='225' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='24' fill='#4fd1c5'>Lipinski (快)</text><rect x='180' y='270' width='280' height='70' rx='10' fill='#1a2531' stroke='#4fd1c5'/><text x='320' y='315' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='24' fill='#f5f7fa'>查溶解 (中)</text><rect x='180' y='360' width='280' height='70' rx='10' fill='#2b2419' stroke='#ffb74d'/><text x='320' y='405' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='24' fill='#ffb74d'>毒性模型 (慢·贵)</text><text x='320' y='480' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='22' fill='#6b7b90'>↑ 拖一拖换顺序</text></g><g text-anchor='middle'><text x='880' y='150' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='26' fill='#8b9bb0'>瀑布图</text><line x1='620' y1='460' x2='1140' y2='460' stroke='#3a4a5a'/><rect x='650' y='190' width='90' height='270' fill='#1a3a44' stroke='#4fd1c5'/><rect x='770' y='320' width='90' height='140' fill='#1a3a44' stroke='#4fd1c5'/><rect x='890' y='400' width='90' height='60' fill='#1a3a44' stroke='#4fd1c5'/><rect x='1010' y='445' width='90' height='15' fill='#1a3a44' stroke='#4fd1c5'/><text x='695' y='175' font-family='monospace' font-size='22' fill='#f5f7fa'>5000</text><text x='1055' y='430' font-family='monospace' font-size='22' fill='#f5f7fa'>9</text></g><text x='640' y='620' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='26' fill='#6b7b90' text-anchor='middle'>把贵关卡挪到最前？看看漏斗变快还是变慢</text></svg>

slides.title: 你交出来的成果
slides.audio_script: 这一节你交出来的，是一条亲手搭好、跑过 5000 个分子的多层漏斗，便宜的关卡排在前；一串从 5000 记到最后的每层剩余数量；再加一张瀑布图，一眼看出哪层砍得最狠、最终收到几个。这就是整台工作台最核心的那条主干。

payload.inline_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 1280 720' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect width='1280' height='720' fill='#0f1419'/><text x='640' y='100' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='44' font-weight='700' fill='#4fd1c5' text-anchor='middle'>本节产物：漏斗 + 剩余串 + 瀑布图</text><g text-anchor='middle'><polygon points='180,200 480,200 410,300 250,300' fill='#1a2531' stroke='#4fd1c5' stroke-width='2'/><text x='330' y='255' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='26' fill='#4fd1c5'>多层漏斗</text><text x='330' y='350' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='22' fill='#8b9bb0'>便宜的排前</text></g><g font-family='monospace' font-size='24' text-anchor='middle' fill='#f5f7fa'><text x='640' y='240'>5000 → 1800</text><text x='640' y='285'>→ 600 → 12</text><text x='640' y='350' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='22' fill='#8b9bb0'>每层剩余串</text></g><g text-anchor='middle'><line x1='840' y1='300' x2='1120' y2='300' stroke='#3a4a5a'/><rect x='860' y='200' width='50' height='100' fill='#1a3a44' stroke='#4fd1c5'/><rect x='935' y='240' width='50' height='60' fill='#1a3a44' stroke='#4fd1c5'/><rect x='1010' y='275' width='50' height='25' fill='#1a3a44' stroke='#4fd1c5'/><text x='980' y='350' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='22' fill='#8b9bb0'>瀑布图</text></g><text x='640' y='480' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='30' fill='#f5f7fa' text-anchor='middle'>你把整台工作台最核心的主干，亲手搭起来了</text><text x='640' y='560' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='26' fill='#6b7b90' text-anchor='middle'>漏斗负责「快速去掉一大堆明显不行的」</text></svg>
bullets: 一条亲手搭好、跑过 5000 个分子的多层漏斗（Lipinski 起，便宜的在前）
一串每层剩余数量：从 5000 一路记到最后剩几个
一张瀑布图：一眼看出哪层砍得最狠、最终收到几个

slides.title: 下一步：给幸存者加权打分，排出 Top10
slides.audio_script: 这一节你搭起了漏斗这条主干，能把几千个分子筛到只剩几个。下一步，漏斗末尾活下来的这少数分子，你会用加权打分给它们排出 Top10。漏斗负责快速去掉一大堆明显不行的，是粗筛；打分负责在活下来的里头精挑细选，是精排。一粗一精接上，最终工作台就快成形了。

payload.inline_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 1280 720' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect width='1280' height='720' fill='#0f1419'/><text x='640' y='180' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='40' font-weight='700' fill='#8b9bb0' text-anchor='middle'>这一节：多层漏斗（粗筛）</text><g text-anchor='middle'><polygon points='520,220 760,220 700,310 580,310' fill='#1a2531' stroke='#4fd1c5' stroke-width='2'/><text x='640' y='275' font-family='monospace' font-size='24' fill='#4fd1c5'>5000 → 12</text></g><text x='640' y='400' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='42' fill='#4fd1c5' text-anchor='middle'>↓</text><text x='640' y='500' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='44' font-weight='700' fill='#f5f7fa' text-anchor='middle'>下一节：加权打分，排出 Top10（精排）</text><text x='640' y='580' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='28' fill='#6b7b90' text-anchor='middle'>一粗一精两步接上，最终工作台就成形了</text></svg>
